mapper.update: UPDATE cut_assessment SET answer_snapshot = CAST(#{query.answerSnapshot} AS JSON), context_snapshot = CAST(#{query.contextSnapshot} AS JSON), manual_grade = #{query.manualGrade}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.assessmentId} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND assessment_status = 'DRAFT' AND current_marker = 1 AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE cut_assessment SET context_snapshot = CAST(#{query.contextSnapshot} AS JSON), manual_grade = #{query.manualGrade}, simple_flow = #{query.simpleFlow}, assessment_status = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_by = #{query.submittedBy}, submitted_at = #{query.submittedAt}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.assessmentId} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND assessment_status = 'DRAFT' AND current_marker = 1 AND deleted = b'0'
